content.short: hashmail provides your Web3 mailbox to send and receive emails.
content.description: Web3 wallets lack a native messaging channel, making direct communication between users and dapps difficult. hashmail introduces email-style messaging to Web3, letting you connect your wallet to a dedicated Web3 inbox and exchange messages with any wallet address or DID. For dapps, our email APIs empower sending essential communications—transaction updates, reminders, statements, and newsletters—to users’ wallet addresses. This approach enhances user experience, boosts engagement, and improves retention.
